sourceTitle: New AI training performance benchmarks for Google TPUs
originalTitle: New AI training performance benchmarks for Google TPUs

blocks.text: In the latest MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark round 1, Google Cloud published 10 results across seventh-generation Ironwood TPUs and NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs, spanning frontier pre-training and the first MLPerf benchmark for agentic reinforcement learning (RL). Built on Google Cloud’s AI Hypercomputer architecture, these results reflect co-design across silicon, networking, and open software:
blocks.zh: 在最新的MLPerf Training v 6.1基准回合1中,Google Cloud发布了跨第七代Ironwood TPU和NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU的10个结果,跨越前沿的前期培训,以及第一个MLPerf强化教学基准(RL).在Google Cloud的 AI Hyper 计算机架构上建造,这些结果反映了跨硅的共同设计,建立网络,和开放软件:
blocks.en: In the latest MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark round 1, Google Cloud published 10 results across seventh-generation Ironwood TPUs and NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs, spanning frontier pre-training and the first MLPerf benchmark for agentic reinforcement learning (RL). Built on Google Cloud’s AI Hypercomputer architecture, these results reflect co-design across silicon, networking, and open software:

blocks.text: Pre-training on Ironwood: 8,192 Ironwood TPUs reached the target model's benchmark target quality in 1.70 minutes, scaling up to 4,096 chips with 96% efficiency.
blocks.zh: 关于铁木的预训:8,192 铁木质TPU在1.70分钟内达到了目标模型的基准目标质量,扩大至4,096个芯片,效率为96%.
blocks.en: Pre-training on Ironwood: 8,192 Ironwood TPUs reached the target model's benchmark target quality in 1.70 minutes, scaling up to 4,096 chips with 96% efficiency.

blocks.text: Agentic RL on Ironwood: 640 Ironwood TPUs reached the target model’s coding benchmark target accuracy in 18.02 minutes (0.765 vs. the 0.69 goal), running code generation and learning simultaneously so training chips waited under 3% of the time.
blocks.zh: 铁杉的代理RL:640 Ironwood TPU在18.02分钟(0.765 vs.0.69目标),运行代码生成和学习 同时 所以训练芯片等待 不到3%的时间。
blocks.en: Agentic RL on Ironwood: 640 Ironwood TPUs reached the target model’s coding benchmark target accuracy in 18.02 minutes (0.765 vs. the 0.69 goal), running code generation and learning simultaneously so training chips waited under 3% of the time.

blocks.text: NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs: On Google Cloud A4X Max Instances, 256 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs reached the target model's benchmark quality in 31.96 minutes, complemented by five A4X and A4X Max submissions on the agentic RL benchmark.
blocks.zh: NVIDIA格蕾丝布莱克威尔GPUs:在Google Cloud A4X Max Incenters上, 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2011-09-02.256 NVIDIA GB300 GPU在31.96分钟内达到了目标模型的基准质量,由5份A4X和A4X 最大值提交剂RL基准作为补充。
blocks.en: NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs: On Google Cloud A4X Max Instances, 256 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs reached the target model's benchmark quality in 31.96 minutes, complemented by five A4X and A4X Max submissions on the agentic RL benchmark.

blocks.text: For more details on the MLPerf Training v6.1 results, click here.
blocks.zh: 关于MLPerf Training v6.1结果的更多细节,点击这里。
blocks.en: For more details on the MLPerf Training v6.1 results, click here.
